fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into Vendor Onboarding
fields.features_subheading: Each new vendor gets one record that fills in as its documents and approvals arrive.
fields.feature_1:
An intake link the vendor fills in

Emergent builds the intake form and the vendor database behind it from your prompt. The vendor's contact fills in company details and files, and it all lands in a database you own.
fields.feature_2:
W-9s and certificates read into fields

The app reads a signed W-9 and a certificate of insurance into structured fields with AI. A value it cannot read with confidence goes to a person to check before the record moves on.
fields.feature_3:
Reminders for anything still missing

A vendor that stops halfway gets an email reminder on the days you pick. If the record is still incomplete after the last one, the buyer who asked for the vendor gets a Slack alert.
fields.feature_4:
Approvers chosen by expected spend

You set the spend lines, and the app sends each new vendor to the right approvers in order. Add as many approvers as your rules need, since none of them takes a paid seat.
fields.feature_5:
New vendors created in your ledger

Connect QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite through their APIs. After the last approval, the app writes the vendor's legal name and payment terms into the ledger, and nobody retypes them.
fields.feature_6:
The onboarding code, in your GitHub

Export the full code of the workflow to your GitHub repository on paid plans. Anyone on your team can read every rule the onboarding follows and change it like any codebase.

fields.usecase_heading: Where Each New Vendor Gets Checked
fields.tab_content_1:
When the W-9 name differs, accounts payable decides

Mossgiel Animal Hospitals adds Calderbrook Lab Supply, and the app emails Iwona Brannoch an intake link. She uploads a signed W-9, and the app reads its legal name and TIN. The TIN matches what she typed. The W-9 says Calderbrook Lab Supply LLC, and Ellery Castellanos in accounts payable confirms the name.
fields.tab_content_2:
The $500,000 certificate goes back to Yarrowby

Hollins Cove Properties asks maintenance vendors for $1,000,000 in general liability per occurrence. Yarrowby Facilities Services uploads a certificate showing $500,000, and the app marks it below minimum. Its contact, Rafferty Velasquez-Fry, gets an email asking for an updated certificate, and Yarrowby waits.
fields.tab_content_3:
Before Ashgrove is paid, someone calls its contract number

Ashgrove Print Co. typed its bank details into Pinewick Brewing's intake form, and the app saved them as unverified. Marguerite Osei in accounts payable gets a task to call Ashgrove at the phone number on its signed contract. Until she marks the call done, Ashgrove's first invoice of $2,340 stays out of payment runs.
fields.tab_content_4:
With $68,000 of spend, Quillon goes to two approvers

Tidewater Robotics routes new vendors by expected annual spend, and anything over $25,000 needs two approvals. Quillon Machining is expected at $68,000 a year. Callum Vance, the engineering lead, approves first, then Ingrid Solberg, the finance director. The app then creates Quillon in NetSuite through its API.

fields.howto_title: How to Build a Vendor Onboarding Workflow
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to decide what a vendor onboarding workflow collects and who approves it, then build and test it in Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down every document you need
fields.howto_step_1_des: List each item a new vendor must send, and mark which ones block the first payment. Each item becomes a field or an upload on the intake form, and anything optional can arrive after approval.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write a coverage minimum for each kind of vendor you hire, with a higher general liability limit for vendors who work on your sites. Ask your insurance broker which limits fit your contracts.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Choose the expected annual spend that adds a second approver, and name who approves on each side of that line. Keep the first approver close to the work, since that person knows whether the vendor is needed.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Name the person who confirms new bank details and the phone number they call. Use a number from a signed contract or an earlier invoice, never one sent in the same email or form as the bank details.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the workflow in a prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste your document list and approval rules into a prompt in plain English. Emergent builds the form and its workflow logic, and you change any rule later by asking for the change.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Link the ledger you already use and map each intake field to a ledger field. Send the legal name from the W-9 to the vendor name field, not the name the vendor typed.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test with 3 vendors you already use
fields.howto_step_7_des: Run 3 current vendors through the workflow, including one whose certificate is below your minimum. Check that every hold and every approval reaches the person you expect before a new vendor gets the link.

faq_plan.q: What is a vendor onboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: A vendor onboarding workflow is the fixed set of steps a business runs to bring on a new vendor before its first payment. It covers an intake form, tax and insurance documents, bank details, and an approval. Each step has an owner, and the vendor goes into the accounting system only after the last approval.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a vendor onboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: Write down the documents you require and the spend line that adds a second approver. Then describe them in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder, which builds the intake form, the vendor database, and the approval workflow as one app. To change a rule later, ask for the change in another prompt.

faq_plan.q: What should a vendor onboarding workflow ask a new vendor to submit?
faq_plan.a: Ask for 4 things before the first payment: a signed W-9, a certificate of insurance that meets your minimum, bank details, and the legal name and address its invoices will carry. Add any license the work needs, such as a trade license for electrical or plumbing work. Mark each item required on the intake form, and a record with a gap cannot move on to approval.

faq_plan.q: How is a vendor onboarding workflow different from onboarding a new hire?
faq_plan.a: A vendor is a business you pay against invoices, and its onboarding checks tax forms and bank details before the first payment. A new hire joins the company and needs equipment and accounts on day one, which an employee onboarding workflow handles. Keep the two apart, because they collect different forms and answer to different owners.

faq_plan.q: Why does a vendor onboarding workflow collect a W-9?
faq_plan.a: It gives you the vendor's correct TIN when you are required to file an information return with the IRS for payments to it. The IRS says to use Form W-9 "to provide your correct Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) to the person who is required to file an information return with the IRS". Apps Emergent builds collect W-9s at intake and keep them with each vendor's payment records.

faq_plan.q: How should a vendor onboarding workflow confirm a vendor's bank details?
faq_plan.a: Confirm them by phone before the first payment, at a number you already hold instead of one sent with the bank details. Record who called and when on the vendor's record, and run the same callback whenever the vendor later asks to change its account.

faq_plan.q: Can vendors complete a vendor onboarding workflow on their own?
faq_plan.a: In the app Emergent builds, they can. Each new vendor gets an intake link, and its contact enters the company details and uploads its documents, then sees which items are still missing. Your team reviews the answers instead of retyping them. The same self-serve pattern runs a client onboarding workflow, where the person filling in the form is a customer, not a vendor.

faq_plan.q: Who should approve a new vendor in a vendor onboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: Have the person who asked for the vendor approve first, then add finance once expected annual spend passes a line you set. Write that line as one number, such as $25,000 a year, and each request goes to the same approvers every time. Apps Emergent builds include every approver you add, with no per-approver seats.

faq_plan.q: Can a vendor onboarding workflow check a vendor's taxpayer ID number?
faq_plan.a: Yes, against the vendor's own W-9: the app compares the TIN on it with the one the vendor typed and sends a mismatch to a person. The IRS adds that "The IRS website offers TIN matching e-services for certain payors to validate name and TIN combinations." Ask your accounts payable lead whether your business is one of those payors.

faq_plan.q: Should freelancers go through a vendor onboarding workflow?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if you pay them as independent businesses against invoices: run them through the same intake and documents as any other vendor. People hired as employees go through hiring instead, which recruitment automation covers. Decide whether a person is a contractor or an employee with your accountant or lawyer, not inside the workflow.
